nodeGroups.name: Publish (text / article / image / multi-image)
nodeGroups.description: Builds the post, picks text, article, single image or multi-image, publishes to LinkedIn. Used by instant posts and the queue.

nodeGroups.name: Edit a post
nodeGroups.description: Changes a live post's text via LinkedIn API and updates the log.

nodeGroups.name: Delete a post
nodeGroups.description: Deletes a live post via LinkedIn API and marks it deleted in the log.

nodeGroups.name: List recent posts
nodeGroups.description: Returns the last 20 rows of linkedin_posts.

nodeGroups.name: Cancel a queued post
nodeGroups.description: Marks a queued row as cancelled so it never publishes.

nodeGroups.name: Daily queue summary
nodeGroups.description: Each morning at 8:00, sends the list of queued posts to Telegram. Silent when the queue is empty.

nodeGroups.name: Upload media
nodeGroups.description: Saves an image Claude sends (base64) to the server and returns a public link for posts.

nodeGroups.name: Serve media
nodeGroups.description: Public GET /webhook/media?f=<file> returns a saved image, or 404.

nodeGroups.name: Media cleanup
nodeGroups.description: Nightly at 3:00: empties hosted images of posts that went live (or ended) 7+ days ago. Queued posts are never touched.

nodeGroups.name: Approve queued post
nodeGroups.description: Approve button: moves a pending_approval row to queued and confirms in Telegram.

nodeGroups.name: Reject queued post
nodeGroups.description: Reject button: marks a pending_approval row cancelled and confirms in Telegram.

nodeGroups.name: Save an idea (Telegram)
nodeGroups.description: Telegram 'idea ...': strips the prefix, saves to the ideas table, replies with the idea number.

nodeGroups.name: List ideas (Telegram)
nodeGroups.description: Telegram /ideas: last 10 open ideas, newest first.

nodeGroups.name: Reconnected (Telegram)
nodeGroups.description: Telegram /reconnected: resets linkedin_connected_at to now.

nodeGroups.name: Status (Telegram)
nodeGroups.description: Telegram /status: queue, approvals, posts this week, open ideas, LinkedIn login age.

nodeGroups.name: Help (Telegram)
nodeGroups.description: Any other Telegram message: list of commands.

nodeGroups.name: LinkedIn login reminder
nodeGroups.description: Daily 9:00: warns from day 50 that the 60-day LinkedIn login is about to expire.

nodeGroups.name: List ideas (webhook)
nodeGroups.description: action=ideas: returns up to 50 open ideas, newest first.

nodeGroups.name: Add idea (webhook)
nodeGroups.description: action=idea_add: saves an idea from Claude.

nodeGroups.name: Update idea (webhook)
nodeGroups.description: action=idea_update: marks an idea used / dropped / open.
